name: 2025 SHAP domain-level retrospective explanation
purpose: Apply the same Step 28B domain interpretation framework to the already generated Step 22 feature-level SHAP values for the 2025 final lockbox forecasts.
actual_2025_role: Retrospective comparison only. 2025 actual values do not change model parameters, SHAP values, domain mapping or explanation contributions.
domain_framework: Same domain grouping rules as Step 28B future SHAP explanations.

domain_aggregation.net_contribution: sum of signed SHAP values inside each domain
domain_aggregation.absolute_influence: sum of absolute SHAP values inside each domain
domain_aggregation.positive_component: sum of positive SHAP values inside each domain
domain_aggregation.negative_component: sum of negative SHAP values inside each domain

interpretation: Positive domain net SHAP pushes the Random Forest prediction above its SHAP baseline; negative domain net SHAP pushes it below the baseline. These values describe model behaviour and do not establish causality. District/geographic context is a model context variable and not a modifiable causal risk factor.
important_validation_note: Step 22B is a retrospective explanation consistency and sanity-check layer. It is not an accuracy validation of SHAP itself and does not prove causal correctness.
